snp5.15:1.1: NIṬṬHITĀ. Posālamāṇavapucchā (14). "Yo atītaṃ ādisati icc-āyasmā Posālo anejo chinnasaṃsayo, pāraguṃ sabbadhammānaṃ atthi pañhena āgamaṃ: || ||
snp5.15:2.1: Vibhūtarūpasaññissa sabbakāyapahāyino ajjhattañ ca bahiddhā ca ‘n' atthi kiñcī' ti passato ñāṇaṃ Sakkānupucchāmi, kathaṃ neyyo tathāvidho". || ||
snp5.15:3.1: "Viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo sabbā Posālā ti Bhagavā abhijānaṃ Tathāgato tiṭṭhantam enaṃ jānāti vimuttaṃ tapparāyanaṃ. || ||
snp5.15:4.1: Ākiñcaññāsambhavaṃ ñatvā ‘nandī saṃyojanaṃ' iti evam evaṃ abhiññāya tato tattha vipassati, etaṃ ñāṇaṃ tathaṃ tassa {brāhmaṇassa} vusīmato" ti || || POSĀLAMĀṆAVAPUCCHĀ
